applicant_name.description: Legal name of the applicant business, exactly as written on the form.

mailing_address.description: Full mailing address of the applicant, on one line.

nature_of_business.description: The type of business, taken only from an explicit business-type description (e.g. 'general contractor').

years_in_business.description: Number of years the business has operated, only if given as a count of years. If a four-digit start year is written instead, leave this blank and use business_start_date.

business_start_date.description: The year the business started, if given as a four-digit year instead of a count of years.

total_receipts.description: Annual gross sales / total receipts in dollars. Digits only, no currency symbols or commas. This is revenue, not payroll.

lines_of_business_requested.description: Each coverage line requested on the application.

line_of_business.description: Name of a single requested coverage line.

prior_carriers.description: Prior insurance carriers listed on the application.

loss_history.description: Prior losses / claims listed on the application.

claim_amount.description: Total claim amount in dollars, digits only.
